mapper.select: select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , '부산' as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '사용가능' and coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(cs.is_deleted, false) = false and ( cs.address like '부산%' or cs.address like '부산광역시%' or cs.address ilike '%Busan%' ) order by random() limit 1
mapper.update: update charger set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where charger_id = #{chargerId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fault_report where charger_id = #{chargerId} and status in ('접수', '점검중', '조치중', '결재대기')
mapper.insert: insert into fault_report ( station_id , charger_id , fault_type , title , description , severity , status , source_type , reported_at , created_at , updated_at ) select c.station_id , c.charger_id , #{faultType} , #{title} , #{description} , #{severity} , '접수' , #{sourceType} , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from charger c where c.charger_id = #{chargerId}
mapper.update: update charger set status = '사용가능', updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp where status = '고장'
mapper.select: select count(*) from charger where status = '고장'

select c.charger_id as chargerId , c.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.status as status , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , case when cs.address like '부산%' then '부산' else split_part(cs.address, ' ', 1) end as regionName , to_char(coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as updatedAtText from charger c join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where c.status = '고장' order by coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at) desc limit 5
mapper.insert: insert into app_member ( user_id , password , member_name , nickname , phone , email , user_type , login_type , status , created_at , updated_at ) select concat('stat_user_', lpad(gs::text, 3, '0')) , null , concat('통계회원', gs) , concat('통계회원', gs) , concat('010-', lpad((7700 + floor((gs - 1) / 100))::int::text, 4, '0'), '-', lpad(gs::text, 4, '0')) , concat('stat_user_', lpad(gs::text, 3, '0'), '@evcharge.test') , 'USER' , 'LOCAL' , 'ACTIVE' , current_timestamp - (gs || ' days')::interval , current_timestamp from generate_series(1, 500) gs on conflict (user_id) do nothing

with model_upsert as ( insert into vehicle_model ( manufacturer , model_name , battery_capacity_kwh , connector_type , max_charging_speed_kw , created_at , updated_at ) values ( '현대' , '아이오닉5' , 72.60 , 'DC콤보' , 200.00 , current_timestamp , current_timestamp ) on conflict (manufacturer, model_name) do nothing returning model_id ), model_pick as ( select model_id from model_upsert union all select model_id from vehicle_model where manufacturer = '현대' and model_name = '아이오닉5' limit 1 ) insert into vehicle ( member_id , model_id , vehicle_nickname , plate_number , is_default , created_at , updated_at ) select m.member_id , (select model_id from model_pick limit 1) , '통계 시연 차량' , concat('STAT', lpad(m.member_id::text, 4, '0')) , true , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from app_member m where m.user_id like 'stat_user_%' and not exists ( select 1 from vehicle v where v.member_id = m.member_id and coalesce(v.is_deleted, false) = false )
mapper.delete: delete from charging_session cs using app_member m where cs.member_id = m.member_id and m.user_id like 'stat_user_%'
delete from reservation r using app_member m where r.member_id = m.member_id and m.user_id like 'stat_user_%'
mapper.insert: with member_vehicle as ( select row_number() over (order by m.member_id) as rn , m.member_id , v.vehicle_id from app_member m join vehicle v on m.member_id = v.member_id and coalesce(v.is_deleted, false) = false where m.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.user_id like 'stat_user_%' ), member_total as ( select count(*)::int as cnt from member_vehicle ), charger_pool as ( select row_number() over (order by c.charger_id) as rn , c.charger_id , coalesce(c.price_per_kwh, 347.20) as price_per_kwh , greatest(coalesce(c.charging_speed_kw, 50), 7) as charging_speed_kw from charger c join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(st.is_deleted, false) = false and coalesce(st.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' and c.status in ('사용가능', '사용중', '예약중') ), charger_total as ( select count(*)::int as cnt from charger_pool ), base as ( select gs.n , ((gs.n - 1) % #{days})::int as day_index , case when ((gs.n * 37) % 100) < 18 then 7 + ((gs.n * 5) % 3) when ((gs.n * 37) % 100) < 30 then 12 + ((gs.n * 3) % 2) when ((gs.n * 37) % 100) < 70 then 18 + ((gs.n * 7) % 4) when ((gs.n * 37) % 100) < 90 then 10 + ((gs.n * 11) % 6) else ((gs.n * 13) % 24) end::int as raw_hour , (((gs.n * 17) % 4) * 15)::int as start_minute , (20 + ((gs.n * 17) % 45))::int as current_soc , (70 + ((gs.n * 19) % 25))::int as target_soc , round((25 + (((gs.n * 23) % 4500) / 100.0))::numeric, 2) as required_kwh from generate_series((#{offset} + 1), (#{offset} + (#{count} * 2))) gs(n) ), time_seed as ( select b.* , (current_date - ((#{days} - 1) - b.day_index))::date as session_date , case when (current_date - ((#{days} - 1) - b.day_index))::date = current_date then least(b.raw_hour, greatest(extract(hour from current_timestamp)::int - 2, 0)) else b.raw_hour end::int as start_hour from base b ), seed as ( select ts.n , mv.member_id , mv.vehicle_id , ch.charger_id , ch.price_per_kwh , ch.charging_speed_kw , ( ts.session_date::timestamp + (ts.start_hour * interval '1 hour') + (ts.start_minute * interval '1 minute') ) as start_time , ts.current_soc , greatest(ts.target_soc, ts.current_soc + 5) as target_soc , ts.required_kwh from time_seed ts cross join member_total mt cross join charger_total ct join member_vehicle mv on mv.rn = (((ts.n - 1) % nullif(mt.cnt, 0)) + 1) join charger_pool ch on ch.rn = ((((ts.n * 7) - 1) % nullif(ct.cnt, 0)) + 1) where mt.cnt > 0 and ct.cnt > 0 ), calc as ( select n , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , price_per_kwh , charging_speed_kw , start_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , greatest(15, ceil(required_kwh / charging_speed_kw * 60))::int as estimated_minutes from seed where target_soc > current_soc ), limited_calc as ( select * from calc where start_time + (estimated_minutes || ' minutes')::interval < current_timestamp order by n asc limit #{count} ), inserted_reservation as ( insert into reservation ( member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , reservation_date , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , estimated_cost , status , auth_code , verified_at , created_at , updated_at ) select member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time::date , start_time , start_time + (estimated_minutes || ' minutes')::interval , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , round(required_kwh * price_per_kwh, 0) , '완료' , concat('ST', lpad(n::text, 12, '0')) , start_time , start_time - interval '15 minutes' , current_timestamp from limited_calc returning reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , estimated_minutes , estimated_cost ) insert into charging_session ( reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , actual_start_time , actual_end_time , start_soc , end_soc , actual_kwh , actual_minutes , actual_cost , status , created_at , updated_at ) select reservation_id , member_id , vehicle_id , charger_id , start_time , end_time , current_soc , target_soc , required_kwh , greatest(1, estimated_minutes) , estimated_cost , '완료' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from inserted_reservation
mapper.select: select count(*) from charging_session where status = '완료'
mapper.delete: delete from notification n where n.receiver_member_id in ( select member_id from app_member where user_id like 'stat_user_%' or user_id like 'demo_user_%' )

delete from file_attachment fa where fa.uploader_member_id in ( select member_id from app_member where user_id like 'stat_user_%' or user_id like 'demo_user_%' ) or ( fa.target_type = 'COMPLAINT' and exists ( select 1 from complaint co where co.complaint_id = fa.target_id and ( co.member_id in ( select member_id from app_member where user_id like 'stat_user_%' or user_id like 'demo_user_%' ) or co.station_id in ( select station_id from charging_station where coalesce(source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or co.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) ) ) ) or ( fa.target_type = 'FAULT' and exists ( select 1 from fault_report f where f.fault_id = fa.target_id and ( f.station_id in ( select station_id from charging_station where coalesce(source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or f.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) ) ) ) or ( fa.target_type = 'INSPECTION' and exists ( select 1 from inspection i join charger c on i.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where i.inspection_id = fa.target_id and coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) ) or ( fa.target_type = 'APPROVAL' and exists ( select 1 from approval_document ad left join fault_report f on ad.fault_id = f.fault_id left join inspection i on ad.inspection_id = i.inspection_id left join charger c1 on f.charger_id = c1.charger_id left join charging_station s1 on c1.station_id = s1.station_id left join charger c2 on i.charger_id = c2.charger_id left join charging_station s2 on c2.station_id = s2.station_id where ad.document_id = fa.target_id and ( coalesce(s1.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' or coalesce(s2.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) ) ) or ( fa.target_type = 'MAINTENANCE' and exists ( select 1 from maintenance_action ma join charger c on ma.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where ma.action_id = fa.target_id and coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) )

delete from maintenance_action ma where ma.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or ma.fault_id in ( select f.fault_id from fault_report f left join charging_station s on f.station_id = s.station_id left join charger c on f.charger_id = c.charger_id left join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' or coalesce(cs.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or ma.inspection_id in ( select i.inspection_id from inspection i join charger c on i.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or ma.approval_document_id in ( select ad.document_id from approval_document ad left join fault_report f on ad.fault_id = f.fault_id left join inspection i on ad.inspection_id = i.inspection_id left join charger cf on f.charger_id = cf.charger_id left join charging_station sf on cf.station_id = sf.station_id left join charger ci on i.charger_id = ci.charger_id left join charging_station si on ci.station_id = si.station_id where coalesce(sf.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' or coalesce(si.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' )

delete from approval_document ad where ad.fault_id in ( select f.fault_id from fault_report f left join charging_station s on f.station_id = s.station_id left join charger c on f.charger_id = c.charger_id left join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' or coalesce(cs.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or ad.inspection_id in ( select i.inspection_id from inspection i join charger c on i.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' )

delete from inspection i where i.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or i.fault_id in ( select f.fault_id from fault_report f left join charging_station s on f.station_id = s.station_id left join charger c on f.charger_id = c.charger_id left join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' or coalesce(cs.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' )

delete from fault_report f where f.station_id in ( select station_id from charging_station where coalesce(source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or f.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' )
mapper.update: update complaint co set station_id = case when co.station_id in ( select station_id from charging_station where coalesce(source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) then null else co.station_id end, charger_id = case when co.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) then null else co.charger_id end, updated_at = current_timestamp where co.station_id in ( select station_id from charging_station where coalesce(source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' ) or co.charger_id in ( select c.charger_id from charger c join charging_station s on c.station_id = s.station_id where coalesce(s.source_type, '') = 'PUBLIC_API' )
mapper.delete: delete from public_api_sync_log where api_name like '%공공%' or api_name like '%환경부%' or sync_type in ('REGION_SAMPLE', 'PUBLIC_API_SAMPLE')
delete from app_member where user_id like 'stat_user_%' or user_id like 'demo_user_%'
